provider_inspection.observed_behavior: SPHINX_OPTS input reaches sphinx-build -M html under set -euo pipefail before the publication step.

guard_intent: Actual public MyST headings have no skipped levels; every course module and the home page have one document title. Literal Markdown code examples are not mistaken for sections.

Actual public MyST targets are globally unique after Docutils normalization, preserving Basic composition and assigning the Element tutorial its own target independently of parallel reader scheduling.

Real home Markdown renders one semantic title and the existing three named sections with both brand images, links and scoped title/typography classes. Removing the title reproduces the three original warnings.

The actual documentation YAML options execute Sphinx on a bad heading. They return failure; removing -W reproduces the old successful exit despite the warning. This protects behavior rather than a flag-shaped string.
Existing schema, navigation, literal rendering and API-to-tutorial guards remain passing with all original notebook payloads preserved.
unsuccessful_attempts: The staged normalizer rejects a line-per-source-item assumption before writing. Its final version preserves original multi-line source-item segmentation and raw JSON formatting.

An initial parallel strict build detects an existing duplicate Basic/Element tutorial label missed in earlier builds. The duplicate sources are unchanged by normalization; the label is separated and an order-independent source guard plus a serial strict build are added.
No browser is available in the session. The temporary loopback server is stopped; only DOM/CSS/source comparisons are claimed, not pixel or screen-reader qualification.
qualification_limits: Source/documentation checks. No website deployment, installed-pair validation, new scientific qualification, release or artifact promotion.
